text:
akshay: Quick triage check for night shift — queue at 40 tickets (was 52 at 10:00). Most are low-priority account questions but we have a cluster of 6 retries related to the webhook handler (see below). Current hotspots: billing duplicates x3, embeddings latency reports x2, webhook retries x6.

akshay: Macros — I pushed a small tweak to the billing macro to mention 'expect up to 48 hours for refunds' and a link to KB. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/142 :eyes:

akshay: Blockers: none blocking deployments. Need someone to own the webhook retry follow-up with eng-infra — looks transient but we should record the root cause once infra finishes digging.

Tess: taking webhook retries and one of the billing dupes. I'll start with the logs, pinging @eng-infra if I see obvious spikes. :thumbsup:

Tess: quick note on macros — the billing PR updates the canned reply, but please don't ship it to the 'urgent' macro set until Liam verifies wording for enterprise SLAs.

liam: looking. For webhook retries — we saw a spike around 22:34 UTC tied to the retry-backoff logic getting duplicate webhooks when the 429 handling retried without idempotency keys. Working with eng-runtime on a temporary mitigation. For now, the manual workaround is to drop duplicates by comparing payload id in the consumer. I'll post logs in #eng-runtime.

nora: I updated the customer-facing macro for embeddings latency FAQ to add a short troubleshooting checklist customers can try (browser cache, SDK upgrade, region). Snippet:```
Hi — sorry for the slowdown. Quick checks:
• Try the latest SDK (>= 1.4.2)
• Switch to a closer region if available
• If using batch/streaming, try smaller batch sizes
We’re investigating on our side and will update here.```

nora: also tagging @support-bot to attach the embeddings-health dashboard snapshot to this thread.

support-bot: Dashboard snapshot (embeddings-latency) attached: https://grafana.internal/d/embeddings/latency?panelId=3 — 99th p90 jump at 22:10 UTC.

akshay: Thanks — Tess + Liam + Nora, appreciate the quick picks. If anyone picks up more than 4 tickets from the cluster call it out here so we can re-balance. I'll consolidate these notes into the daily handoff doc shortly.

akshay: One favor — please add any macro wording edits as a single comment on the PR so we have a clear review trail. Will merge after liam sign-off.

Tess: noted, will add comments and update if needed.

liam: I can sign off on wording by 02:30 UTC after I confirm with eng-runtime on the mitigation.

nora: grabbing two more low-priority tickets (IDs 50124, 50129) and will leave the rest for morning queue. Good handoff. :coffee:
